description: Two first-order axiom sets are equivalent if and only if their consequence closures are equal.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Theories.equivalent_iff_closure_eq.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (T U : L.Theory) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Theories.Equivalent T U ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Theories.consequenceClosure T =
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Theories.consequenceClosure U
